mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS roomId, r.name AS roomName, r.capacity AS capacity, COUNT(rsv.id) AS totalReservations, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN rsv.status IN ('CHECKED_IN','COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS completedReservations, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN rsv.status IN ('CHECKED_IN','COMPLETED') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rsv.start_time, rsv.end_time) ELSE 0 END ) / 60.0, 0) AS totalSeatHours FROM study_room r LEFT JOIN reservation rsv ON rsv.room_id = r.id AND rsv.deleted = 0 AND rsv.start_time >= #{from} AND rsv.start_time < #{to} WHERE r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.capacity ORDER BY totalReservations DESC, r.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.student_no AS studentNo, COUNT(rsv.id) AS reservationCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rsv.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rsv.status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS noShowCount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN rsv.status IN ('CHECKED_IN','COMPLETED') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rsv.start_time, rsv.end_time) ELSE 0 END ) / 60.0, 0) AS totalHours FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN reservation rsv ON rsv.user_id = u.id AND rsv.deleted = 0 AND rsv.start_time >= #{from} AND rsv.start_time < #{to} WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'STUDENT' GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.student_no ORDER BY reservationCount DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT HOUR(rsv.start_time) AS hour, COUNT(rsv.id) AS reservationCount FROM reservation rsv WHERE rsv.deleted = 0 AND rsv.start_time >= #{from} AND rsv.start_time < #{to} GROUP BY HOUR(rsv.start_time) ORDER BY hour ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.credit_score AS creditScore, COUNT(cl.id) AS violationCount, COALESCE(-SUM(cl.delta), 0) AS totalDeduction FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN credit_log cl ON cl.user_id = u.id AND cl.delta < 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.student_no, u.credit_score ORDER BY totalDeduction DESC, violationCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS roomId, r.name AS roomName, COUNT(sf.id) AS totalFaults, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sf.status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openFaults, MAX(sf.created_at) AS latestFaultAt FROM study_room r LEFT JOIN seat s ON s.room_id = r.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN seat_fault sf ON sf.seat_id = s.id AND sf.created_at >= #{from} AND sf.created_at < #{to} WHERE r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY totalFaults DESC, r.id ASC
